title: Business days from a weekend start
spec: Implement add_business_days(start, n) for a datetime.date start and an integer n of at least 0. Business days are Monday to Friday; there are no holidays. If start falls on a Saturday or Sunday, first move forward to the following Monday. Then move forward n business days. Consequently n == 0 returns start itself on a weekday and the following Monday on a weekend, and Friday plus one business day is the next Monday.
target_defect: An early return for n == 0 skips the weekend adjustment, so a weekend start with n == 0 returns the weekend date.
author_rationale: Replace the day-by-day loop with constant-time arithmetic.
limitations: Synthetic module written by the repository's AI engineering agent after the November 2026 development pilot saturated corpus v1, before any model reviewed it.
